system: Yakıt Ölçümü & Hava Emiş / Kam Mili Zamanlaması
symptoms: Visually inspect the wiring and connectors associated with the fuel shutoff valve "A" control circuit. Look for any loose connections, damaged wires, or corrosion. Repair or replace as necessary.

Test the fuel shutoff valve to ensure it is functioning correctly. This can be done using a multimeter to measure the resistance across the valve's terminals. If the resistance is outside of the specified range, the valve may need to be replaced.

Check the power and ground supply to the fuel shutoff valve. Use a multimeter to measure the voltage at the valve's terminals with the ignition turned on. If there is no voltage or an abnormal voltage reading, further diagnosis of the fuel system and ECM may be required.

If all electrical components check out, it may be necessary to perform a more in-depth diagnosis using specialized diagnostic equipment. This can involve capturing live data from the ECM to analyze fuel pressure, injector operation, and other parameters.
